summary: Record the Nex Core 0.2.5 ISO and package build and its publication to the signed APT archive and the website download tree (carrying BUG-0189 to BUG-0192), with the public HTTPS verification. API impact: none — release evidence only.

guide.reason: Release evidence only; operator install and update workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: none. Build and publication record; no Controller, Core or client contract changes.

roadmap.reason: Patch release publication; no milestone or acceptance gate change.

state.reason: Release artifacts live on the website host and in the build output; no pool or Controller state is added.

verification.method: Local build exit 0 and package versions checked with dpkg-deb; fix markers checked in the embedded source archive and the Core executable; publication verified over public HTTPS (InRelease, Packages listing both 0.2.5 packages with matching sizes, ISO sha256 equal to the build, latest serving 0.2.5). Both published packages were downloaded again and their SHA-256 digests equal the built packages.
